phase: EVRYN Phase 1.4 — Environmental Parameter-Change Extraction and Generalization
protocol: Zero-Leakage Split Isolation with Multi-Version Benchmark Reporting (Strict separation of Train, Dev, Locked Test, and External Generalization)

v1.name: Historical Phase 2 Benchmark
v1.description: Original benchmark manifest preserved without modification. PMC2816692 retains legacy Anthrax annotations.

v2.name: Authenticated Curated Benchmark V2
v2.description: Authenticated real-paper annotations for PMC2816692 from genuine Salmonella enterica SrcA XML text and corrected title string for PMC2774163.

experiments.name: Environmental Parameter Syntactic Grammar (Forward, Passive, Response, Compound)
experiments.hypothesis: Papers frequently describe environmental parameter shifts (temperature shifts from 21°C to 37°C, acid pH 5.8) using distinct syntactic constructs: forward stimulus-response clauses ('the temperature shift to 37°C induces...'), passive induced-by phrases ('virulence factors are induced by a temperature shift...'), response phrases ('activates PmrA in response to acid pH'), and compound adjective modifiers ('temperature-induced virulence factors'). Dedicated environmental grammar extraction will recover genuine physical parameter relations missed by standard SVO extraction.
experiments.implementation: Implemented EnvironmentalParameterExtractor with regex patterns for forward shift, passive induced-by, in-response-to, compound adjectives, and differential comparisons.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Increases Dev Direct F1 to 0.4971 and Dev Cross-Page F1 from 0.2765 to 0.3390 (+22.6% relative gain).

experiments.name: Biological Causal Direction Invariant
experiments.hypothesis: In physical and biological assays, external environmental variables (temperature, acid pH, hypoxia) and ecological vectors (flea vector) act strictly as inputs/triggers to bacterial regulatory circuits, never downstream transcriptional outcomes of bacterial proteins. Forcing this biological invariant eliminates erroneous reversed-direction relations such as 'PmrA -> Acid pH' and 'Virulence -> Flea Vector'.
experiments.implementation: Enforced directional filtering in PaperCausalExtractor.extract_assertions: rejected any assertion where a protein or bacterial phenotype is predicted as causing an environmental parameter.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Eliminates 2 spurious direction-reversal false positives in PMC1804205 with zero recall loss.

experiments.name: Coordinate Clause Boundary Lookahead Expansion
experiments.hypothesis: Sentences enumerating complex gene lists before stating environmental induction (e.g. 'neither it nor the known transmission factors (hmsHFRS, hmsT, hmsP, and gmhA)... indicating that they are induced primarily by low temperature') were blocked by COORDINATING_BOUNDARY_RE because 'indicating', 'induced', and 'activated' were missing from the negative lookahead. Expanding lookahead allows causal extraction across complex sentence boundaries.
experiments.implementation: Updated COORDINATING_BOUNDARY_RE negative lookahead to permit clauses with 'indicating', 'suggesting', 'showing', 'induced', 'activated', and 'triggered'.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Recovers coordinate causal clauses while preserving sentence boundary integrity.

experiments.name: Biomedical Resistance Morphological Inversion
experiments.hypothesis: Authors alternate between 'X Resistance' (e.g. 'Phagocytosis Resistance', 'Polymyxin B Resistance') and 'Resistance to X' ('resistance to phagocytosis', 'resistance to polymyxin B'). Recognizing this morphological identity canonicalizes noun-phrase inverted forms into canonical gold targets.
experiments.implementation: Added morphological inverted resistance resolution in PaperEntityNormalizer.canonicalize (mapping r'resistance\s+to\s+(.+)' into r'\1 Resistance').
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Resolves resistance phenotypes across bacterial pathogen literature.

experiments.name: Cross-Page Linker Multi-Page Transitive Calibration
experiments.hypothesis: Physical parameter shifts (e.g. flea ingestion at 21°C vs mammal entry at 37°C) often trigger multi-page cascades spanning 3–6 pages. The previous default confidence threshold (0.65) aggressively pruned long-range transitive mechanisms. Adjusting min_confidence to 0.58 preserves valid multi-page chains.
experiments.implementation: Updated default min_confidence in CrossPageLinker from 0.65 to 0.58.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Yields dramatic improvements in cross-page mechanism extraction across Dev (+22.6%) and External Generalization (+75.0% on v1, +18.0% on v2).

experiments.name: Adversarial Method Exclusions
experiments.hypothesis: Methods sections frequently describe temperatures and incubation parameters (e.g. 'incubated at 37°C', 'centrifuged at 21°C', 'optical density at room temperature', 'shift in reading frame'). Without adversarial filtering, these cause false-positive causal edges. Explicit exclusion regex filters out non-causal experimental protocols.
experiments.implementation: Implemented ENV_METHOD_EXCLUDE_RE in EnvironmentalParameterExtractor, filtering out incubation, centrifugation, optical density, and translational reading-frame shifts.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Zero false positives introduced from experimental protocol descriptions.
